00 · Start here
A growth breakdown for Melty
Why we made this

You have shipped four launches in three weeks: Melty on 4 October, then Melty MCP, Melty Chat and, on 25 October, Melty Net, with 256 player multiplayer in any game, mod or mashup. David's launch videos have passed 3.4 million views between them, and makers are already posting their own: one clip of Leon in the Lands Between passed 2 million TikTok plays.

Mashups are made for short video: two games people love, combined, played with friends, on camera. This board is how we would put that in front of PC players every day. It is free, so take whatever is useful.

How to read this board
Use the list on the left, or press P to go frame by frame. On a phone, just scroll.
Creator cards: platform, followers and median views on recent videos.
Please note
Made by hypjam from public information, checked 26 Oct 2026. Nobody at Melty asked for this, and it is not paid work. The creators named here have not been contacted and have no link to hypjam: they show the kind of people we would cast.
12 PC gaming creators shortlisted, 4 scripts with 32 hooks, and a first month built around Melty Net and the mashups already on Melty.
Four numbers to remember
3.4M: views on David's four launch videos since 4 October
256: players in one game, mod or mashup with Melty Net
2M: TikTok plays on one maker's clip of Leon in the Lands Between, now on Melty
95%: of Steam users are on Windows, where Melty runs (Steam survey, September 2026)
Who made this

hypjam is a UGC agency in London. We cast, script, direct and edit creators for consumer startups, and run the best videos as ads.

01 · Why UGC
Why creator videos work
Authenticity
People trust people
"One click" is a claim. A creator pressing Play and landing in Skyrim as a Minecraft player a few seconds later is proof.
Show, do not tell
A mashup explains itself
Two games people already love, on one screen. Nobody needs the idea explained once they have seen it for two seconds.
Objections
Answer "do I need the games?" out loud
Mashups run on games you own. A creator saying so on camera, with both games in their own library, answers it before anyone asks.
A new launch
Melty Net is brand new
256 player multiplayer went live on 25 October. Couples and friend groups joining from one link is a fresh story people want to try with their own friends.
Fuel for ads
Your best ads come from creators
Videos that already work on TikTok can run as Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads, with 8 openings per script, so the budget follows what people actually watch.
Doesn't feel like an ad
Looks like a normal post
So people actually watch it instead of scrolling past. It is still labelled as an ad, it just does not feel like one.
02 · What we learned
Where Melty is today
The product
A free app for Windows to discover, play and create mashups and mods for the games you already own. Press Play and Melty installs what it needs and starts the game, and uninstalling puts every file back. Multiplayer mashups come with an invite link or a public lobby, and you can make your own by giving Melty's instructions to Claude Code or Codex.
The offer
Free. Melty and its mashups cost nothing. Mashups run on games you own, and if one is missing, Melty sends you to its store. Every upload is checked for dangerous files. Backed by Y Combinator, F26.
Your own channels
David's launches on X: 1.5M views on Melty (4 Oct), 250K on Melty MCP (11 Oct), 538K on Melty Chat (14 Oct) and 1.1M on Melty Net (25 Oct). @meltylauncher's mashup drops: 39.8K on Elden Ring + Kingdom Hearts, 25.9K on Leon in the Lands Between and 22.5K on Silksong + Celeste.
Already in motion
  • Makers post their mashups on TikTok and send people to melty.gg: the first test build of Leon in the Lands Between went out on 12 October.
  • A clip of SSJKilam's Elden Ring and Kingdom Hearts mashup drew 441.6K views on X, and it went live on Melty the same day.
  • David replies to players on X many times a day.
What that tells us
The demo travels on its own: your launch videos reach hundreds of times your follower count, and mashup clips from small accounts break out. What is missing is volume: PC creators showing mashups on TikTok and Shorts every day.
The timing
Melty Net went live on 25 October. 95% of Steam users are on Windows, the platform Melty runs on. Videos started in early November are tested and cut by Thanksgiving week, when friends are home.
Sources: melty.gg, its FAQ, privacy policy and terms, the YC company page, posts by @davidmilr, @meltylauncher and @VideoArtGame on X, TikTok posts by @supmyninja07, and the Steam Hardware & Software Survey (September 2026), all read 26 Oct 2026.
03 · The category
Mods and mashups on short video
Mods are already a big genre on TikTok. Mod picks, big modlists and one game inside another pull hundreds of thousands of plays.
Mod picks
A daily habit
@hardcorehalfling posts Fallout 4 mod picks with a median of 138.8K plays on his last 9 videos, and says which mods are PC only.
Modlists
Big builds, big views
A Skyrim modlist video @bigbustersword posted on 6 October has 938.8K plays. "The modding community is next level," he told a viewer on 25 October.
Crossovers
One game inside another
"i made bo2 in elden ring", posted on 2 October, has 106.3K plays, and @thisisskyrim posted a Baldur's Gate character mod in Skyrim on 17 October.
Makers
Built with AI, shared on TikTok
@supmyninja07 says he is building Leon in the Lands Between using AI. A clip he posted on 10 October has passed 2M plays, and two days later he posted that the first test build was out on melty.gg.
Playing together
Multiplayer Skyrim already has its own regulars on TikTok, like @checkpointjordan's Whiterun guard captain on a roleplay server, posted as a running series.
The opening for Melty
People already watch mods and mashups by the hundred thousand. Melty is where a viewer can press Play on the one they just watched, with friends, on games they own.
Sources: public TikTok posts by @hardcorehalfling, @bigbustersword, @l.austinnn, @thisisskyrim, @supmyninja07 and @checkpointjordan, read 26 Oct 2026.
04 · The objection
Games and files: the objection to win
Every new viewer will wonder two things: do I need the games, and what happens to my game files? Your answers are clear, and they belong in the videos.
What you already say
  • Mashups run on games you own. If you're missing one, Melty sends you to its store.
  • Uninstalling puts every file back as it was.
  • Every upload is checked for dangerous files. If a mashup looks wrong, report it from its page.
  • Melty and its mashups are free.
How we use it
Every script keeps one line on camera: "you need both games, and I own both". Script A shows the Play button and the uninstall that puts every file back.
Show it as it happens
Creators film Melty on their own Windows PC, exactly as it behaves on the day, with games from their own library. Nothing is mocked up.
Within each game's rules
Your terms ask players to play mashups within each game's rules. Creators film single player or private sessions, never mods in competitive online play.
What creators never say
No "free games", no safety claims beyond your own words, no hint that a game's publisher made or backs a mashup, and nothing your site does not say Melty does.
Sources: melty.gg FAQ and Melty's terms (last updated 18 Oct 2026), read 26 Oct 2026.
05 · Audience
Who to sell to first
Start here
PC players with a big library
Skyrim, Elden Ring, Fallout and Silksong players who already own the games a mashup needs. One click and they are playing something new tonight. Formats A and D.
Start here
Couples and friend groups who game together
Adults who already plan game nights. One invite link and everyone is in the same mashup, which is exactly what Melty Net is for. Format B.
Broadest reach
Mod fans who watch more than they install
People who love mod videos on TikTok. "Forget setup. Play in one click" is your own line, and it is written for them. Formats A and D.
Early adopters
Makers with a coding agent
Claude Code and Codex users who want to build something fun. Melty's instructions turn a prompt into a published mashup. Format C.
Where we would start
PC players with a big library first, then couples and friend groups as Melty Net grows. They already own the games, so the step from video to playing is one download. Every creator we cast and every audience we target is an adult.
06 · The moment
Right after Melty Net
Melty Net launched on 25 October: 256 player multiplayer in any game, mod or mashup. The next few weeks are the time to show friend groups what it looks like.
Now to 8 November
Mashup reveals (Script A) and couples or friends in one lobby (Script B) are filmed. Each creator plays their mashup before filming it.
9 to 22 November
First videos go live. Makers build their own (Script C) and lists of mashups to play tonight (Script D) start earning saves. Budget moves to the winning hooks.
Thanksgiving week
Friends are home and game nights get planned. Friend-lobby videos lead, and the best ones run as TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads.
What this needs from you
  • A list of mashups creators may show, and how makers like to be credited
  • A download link or code per creator, so downloads trace back to videos
  • David for a founder cut of Script C, if he wants one
Why start now
Your launch videos have already put Melty in front of millions on X. Creator videos started now reach PC players on TikTok and Shorts while Melty Net is still new.
07 · The first month
Your first four weeks
Week 1 · 2-8 Nov
You approve the shortlist and the 4 formats. We sign creators and send each a script with 8 hooks. Each confirms they own the games for their mashup and plays it before filming.
Week 2 · 9-15 Nov
First videos come in, and we review each within 48 hours. Mashup reveals and friend lobbies first.
Week 3 · 16-22 Nov
First videos go live, plus the first maker video. The best openings start as TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads, each with its creator's own link.
Week 4 · 23-29 Nov
Thanksgiving week: budget on the winning hooks, then a results review together: downloads by creator and by ad, and the plan for December.
If it is a yes this week
Agreement signed and creators playing Melty by Friday. First videos live within 14 days of the scripts being signed off.

Your own launches travel hundreds of times past your follower count, and so do small makers' mashup clips. The format works from any size of account.
Takeaway
Mashup clips break out when the moment is simple: one character dropped into another game. Founder launches travel too. So we would run David's launches and creator volume side by side, testing 8 hooks per script.
Where the market is
Mod creators post every day on TikTok, and the biggest mod videos are picks, modlists and crossovers. We did not find PC creators filming friends joining one mashup from an invite link. That lane is open.
10 · Script A
Script A: Two games I own, one mashup
The brief

Where: TikTok and YouTube Shorts from the creator's account, plus TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads to melty.gg (15s and 30s cuts)

Length: 35-40s master. 30s cut: shots 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 8. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 3 and 8 (hook, disclosure, one click, CTA).

Goal: Downloads of Melty for Windows at melty.gg

Who films it: A US PC gaming creator, 18+, who already owns both games the mashup needs, in their own library, on their own Windows PC. Filmed at their own desk: a phone on the monitor for face shots, plus screen capture of Melty and the game. They play the mashup off camera first, so the reaction is to a moment they chose, not a first boot.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. I played Skyrim as a Minecraft playerI just played Skyrim as a Minecraft player, and it took one click.
  2. Leon from Resident Evil 4... in Elden RingThat's Leon. From Resident Evil 4. In Elden Ring.
  3. Two games I already own. One button.I own both of these games. Watch what one button does.
  4. POV: you find out you can combine your gamesNobody told me you could combine the games you already own.
  5. Rate this mashup out of 10Rate this mashup out of ten. I'll go first.
  6. Which two games should I combine next?I combined two of my games. Tell me which two are next.
  7. Hollow Knight Silksong + Celeste is realSilksong and Celeste in one game. It's real, and I'm playing it.
  8. No setup. I pressed Play.No mod setup. I pressed Play and it started.

11 · Script B
Script B: One link, everyone is in
The brief

Where: TikTok and YouTube Shorts from the creator's account; the best cut as a TikTok Spark Ad and a Meta partnership ad to melty.gg

Length: 35-45s master. 15s cut: shots 1, 2, 4 and 8.

Goal: Downloads, and friends joining from an invite link

Who films it: A gaming couple or a friend group, every person 18+, each on their own Windows PC with their own copy of every game the mashup needs. Filmed in one room (two desks) or with a phone over each screen. Everyone on camera agrees to be filmed, and only multiplayer mashups that are live on Melty that day.

Publish only what the creator has the right to share: no game files or other makers' work they cannot share, and credit any mod they build on. Show the agent's real output and the real time it took; label any speed-up. Never show API keys, tokens or account details. Describe making a mashup only the way melty.gg does: copy Melty's instructions into Claude Code or Codex and say what you want.

Why it should convert
Your MCP and Chat launches show that making is the story people share. A creator going from a prompt to friends playing turns viewers into makers, and every new mashup is something new to post about.
13 · Script D
Script D: Mashups you can play tonight
The brief

Where: TikTok and YouTube Shorts from the creator's account; built for saves, with the best cut as a Spark Ad

Length: 25-35s, five fast entries.

Goal: Saves, follows and downloads

Who films it: A US game discovery creator, 18+, who owns the games for every mashup on the list and plays each one before filming. Voiceover over screen capture is fine. Only mashups live on Melty on the posting day, each credited to its maker.

8 hooks to test (on screen, then spoken)
  1. 5 game mashups you can play tonightFive game mashups you can play tonight, if you own the games.
  2. Your game library can do thisYour game library can do things you didn't know about.
  3. Save this for your next game nightSave this for your next game night.
  4. Mashups ranked: which would you play first?I ranked these mashups. Tell me which one you'd play first.
  5. Free mashups for games you already ownThese mashups are free. You just need the games.
  6. Elden Ring + Kingdom Hearts is a real thing nowElden Ring plus Kingdom Hearts is a real thing now.
  7. Combos I didn't think were possibleCombos I didn't think were possible, and I've played all of them.
  8. Silksong + Celeste. Number one.Silksong plus Celeste. That one is number one.
Shot list
TimeWhat we seeOn screenSpoken

Product moment and call to action

Melty named at 0:02; every entry shows the mashup and the games it needs, so the 'do I need the games?' question is answered before anyone asks.

CTA: Save the list, then download Melty at melty.gg.

Caption
Ad | Paid partnership with @meltylauncher. 5 mashups on Melty for games you already own: [list, with makers]. Free on Windows at melty.gg. Which one first? #ad #melty #pcgaming #mods #gamingtips
Rules for this video

FTC: 'Ad | Paid partnership with Melty' on screen from 0s to the end, said out loud by 0:05, the platform label switched on (TikTok 'Paid partnership', YouTube 'Includes paid promotion', Instagram and Facebook 'Paid partnership'), and the caption opens with the disclosure. Games: the creator owns every game the mashup needs, in their own library, and says so on camera; never suggest a mashup gives anyone a game for free. Name games and mashups exactly as Melty or the maker names them, credit the maker in the caption, and never imply a game's publisher made, approves or sponsors Melty or the mashup. Show Melty exactly as it behaves on the day on the creator's own Windows PC: never mock up an install, a lobby, a prompt or a mashup, and only show mashups that are live on Melty that day. Safety in Melty's own words only ('Every upload is checked for dangerous files'): no 'safe', 'virus-free' or 'can't get banned' claims. Single player or private sessions, played within each game's rules: no mods in competitive online play. Adults only (18+) on camera and on mic. List only mashups live on Melty on the posting day, with the games each one needs on screen. No rankings of other apps, launchers or mod sites.

Why it should convert
Lists earn saves, and saves keep a video showing for weeks. Every entry is a reason to download, and the needs line answers the first question before anyone asks it.

16 · Ads
How the paid ads would run
1 · Film
Each script is shot once, with 8 different openings.
→
2 · Launch
Each opening runs as its own ad, from the creator's handle as a partnership ad.
→
3 · Read
After a few days we compare cost per download and how many people watch past 3 seconds.
4 · Cut
The weakest openings switch off and the budget moves to the best two.
→
5 · Remix
Winning hooks get new bodies and new creators.
→
6 · Refresh
New creator videos every week, so the ads never go stale.
Where the ads point
melty.gg, through one link per creator, so every download traces back to the video that drove it. The same videos run as TikTok Spark Ads and Meta partnership ads, shown to adult PC players.
Why partnership ads
Ads that run from a creator's own handle look like that creator's post, not a brand ad. That is the format these videos are built for.
What we would need
Access to your TikTok and Meta ad accounts (or we run them from ours), downloads by link, and a weekly look at the numbers.
17 · Process
How a campaign runs, step by step
1 · Brief
You tell us the goal, the audience and what can and can't be said about Melty.
→
2 · Cast
We shortlist creators by niche, location and median views. You pick.
→
3 · Offer
We send each creator the brief, the dates and the rate.
4 · Sign
A written agreement with every creator, covering usage and disclosure.
→
5 · Scripts
One per format: 8 hooks, a shot list, screens to record and a caption.
→
6 · Film and upload
Creators film on their phones and upload to a private folder only we see.
7 · Review
We check every video within 48 hours. Nothing posts unapproved.
→
8 · Post
On the creator's own account, with the ad disclosure and the paid-partnership label.
→
9 · Pay and report
Creators paid within 7 days of going live. You get a report every Monday.
Where creators talk to us
One hypjam Discord for every creator. Each campaign gets a private channel group for chat, scripts and posted links that only its creators and your team can see.
Games
Each signed creator plays Melty on their own Windows PC with games from their own library, and plays every mashup before filming it, so what shows on screen is really theirs.
18 · Reporting
What we report, and when
Every video
Views, how many people stay past 3 seconds, average watch time, saves, shares and comments.
Every creator link
A tracking link for each creator, so downloads trace back to the video that drove them.
Every Monday
A short report: every video, the hooks that won, downloads by creator, and what we change next.
Every month
A review call: spend, downloads, cost per result on anything run as an ad, and the plan for next month.
19 · Rules
Rules we never break
Disclosure
"Ad | Paid partnership with Melty" on screen, said in the first seconds, and the platform's paid-partnership label on. That is what the FTC asks for.
Who films
Adults only (18+). Creators use Melty themselves before they talk about it.
What gets said
Nothing your own pages do not say Melty does. No invented numbers. We never pay for a positive opinion, only for the video.
Games people own
Every creator owns every game their mashup needs, and says so. No video suggests a game comes free with Melty, and none implies a game's publisher made or backs a mashup.
Within each game's rules
Single player or private sessions only, played within each game's rules. No mods in competitive online play, and every mashup's maker is credited by name.
How we run it
Every video reviewed within 48 hours before it posts. Creators paid within 7 days of going live.
